title: Background music per zone, egg flow polish, pet stay-at-destructible behavior
description: 1. Add per-zone background music with crossfade on zone change. 2. Polish egg hatching E-key flow (direct hatch on ProximityPrompt). 3. Fix pet behavior: slow approach to destructibles, stay there bouncing, only return when destroyed or player >60 studs away.
steps: Add zone music data to ZoneData.lua with Roblox asset IDs per zone
Create MusicController on client that manages a Sound in SoundService, crossfades between zone tracks
Wire MusicController into Main.client.lua with zone detection based on player position
Fix ProximityPrompt E-key to directly invoke HatchEgg without intermediate UI confirmation
Rewrite PetController attack behavior: slow lerp to destructible (speed 2-3), stay at target with bounce animation, only return when destructible destroyed or player >60 studs away
acceptance_criteria: Each zone plays a different background track using known Roblox asset IDs
E-key on ProximityPrompt triggers egg hatch directly (server validates cost)
Pets approach destructibles at slow speed (lerp 2-3)
Pets stay at destructibles bouncing (not returning between attacks)
Pets only return when destructible is destroyed or player is >60 studs away
Pets hover ~1 stud beside the destructible (not inside it)
